question: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana–Urban (PMAY-U) was launched in the year ________ by the Government of India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2015**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana–Urban (PMAY-U) was launched in 2015 by the Government of India.
 
• The scheme aims to provide affordable housing to the urban poor with a target of building 20 million (2 crores) affordable houses by 31 March 2022.
 
• It is implemented by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA).
 
• PMAY-U is aligned with the vision of "Housing for All" by 2022, a flagship mission of the Government of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Components of PMAY-U**

 
 
• **In-Situ Slum Redevelopment (ISSR):** Using land as a resource with private sector participation for providing houses to eligible slum dwellers.
 
• **Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS):** Providing interest subsidy on housing loans to EWS, LIG, MIG-I, and MIG-II beneficiaries.
 
• **Affordable Housing in Partnership (AHP):** Financial assistance to EWS houses being built with different agencies.
 
• **Beneficiary-led Individual House Construction/Enhancement (BLC):** Assistance to individual eligible families of EWS categories to either construct new houses or to enhance existing houses.
 
 
 
• **Technology Sub-Mission:** Focuses on the adoption of modern, innovative, and green technologies and building materials for faster and quality construction of houses.
 
• **Eligibility:** The scheme is targeted at the urban poor including Economically Weaker Sections (EWS), Lower Income Groups (LIG), and Middle Income Groups (MIG).
 
• **Funding:** The scheme is funded through the central government and various financial institutions to ensure the availability of required funds for the effective implementation of the mission.
